lines.en: Excuse me. Where are the pencils and erasers?
They are in the box by the window.
Thank you. I also need a ruler and scissors.
The scissors are here. Is this for a child?
Yes, my grandson starts school next week.
lines.ko: 네, 손자가 다음 주에 학교에 들어가요.

lines.en: Then he will need a notebook and a pen too.
Good idea. How much is this notebook?
It's not much. Only two thousand, Ma'am.
I bought the wrong pen last time. Is this blue?
lines.ko: 지난번에 펜을 잘못 샀어요. 이건 파란색이에요?

lines.en: Yes, it's blue. Have a nice day!
Do you have your pencils for tomorrow?
Yes, Grandma. Two pencils and one eraser.
lines.ko: 네, 할머니. 연필 두 자루하고 지우개 하나요.

lines.en: Where is your ruler? I don't see it.
Oh, I left it on my desk yesterday.
lines.ko: 아, 어제 제 책상 위에 두고 왔어요.

lines.en: Please get it. And take your notebook too.
Okay. Do I need the scissors today?
Yes. Your teacher said so last week.
I will put them in the box now.
Good. Is this the wrong pen? It's red.
Yes, I need the black one. Thanks, Grandma!
